chores.title: Refresh Codex plugins
chores.why: Rebuilds the Codex edition of these plugins, installs it into Codex, then checks it

chores.title: Remove retired plugins
chores.why: sdlc, ui-test and factory now live in pm; an old copy still installed loads twice
chores.run: for p in sdlc ui-test factory; do claude plugin uninstall "$p@dc-dev-plugins" || true; done; claude plugin list

chores.title: Check tracker setup
chores.why: Checks the tracker sign-in and repo, and creates any of Runway's labels that are missing
